(Currently Amended) 1. A method for controlling a flow of air, the method comprising: establishing a level of vacuum in a booster device by generating a flow of air from the booster device using a pump; determining whether the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value; and terminating the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached the predetermined value, wherein said terminating step includes utilizing a controller to manage the flow termination.

(Currently Amended) 8. A system for controlling a flow of air, the system comprising: a booster device configured to provide a vacuum assist when a level of vacuum has been established in the device; a pump configured to establish the level of vacuum in the booster device by generating a flow of air from the booster device; and a directional control valve adapted to terminate the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value, wherein said directional control valve includes a feedback mechanism to enhance the flow termination process.

(Currently Amended) 14. A motor vehicle comprising: an internal combustion engine; a booster device configured to provide a vacuum assist when a level of vacuum has been established in the device; and a system for controlling a flow of air from the booster device, the system including: a pump configured to establish the level of vacuum in the booster device by generating the flow of air from the booster device; and a directional control valve adapted to terminate the flow of air from the booster device when the level of vacuum in the booster device has reached a predetermined value, such that a pressure differential across the pump is reduced and optimized for engine performance.
